#--------------------------- ABOUT THIS SCRIPT: ---------------------------#

title: Fear Test Analysis 
author: Narendra Solanki (NS)
last update: 01.03.2024

#-description procedure:
#### Phase 1: 4 steps (habituation to context/tone/E-chock[reaction expected]/pause=habituation)
#### Phase 2: 1 step (habituation) <-CONTEXT conditioning?
#### Phase 3: 2 steps (habituation new env /tone) <-CUE CONDITIONNING
#### +5 days
#### Phase 4: 1 step (habituation) <-LG terme CONTEXT conditioning?
#### Phase 5: 2 steps (habituation new env /tone) <-LG terme CUE CONDITIONNING

#-columns of interest:
#  (Dis.)   Distance traveled (cm?)
#  (Rear)   Total number of rearing bouts
#  (FreXY)  Total number of freezing bouts
#  (FreDXY) Total duration of all freezing bouts
#  (Jump)   Total number of Jumping bouts

#-parameters
#  Phase 1 - part 3 (E-Stim): CONTROL - all animal Jump (at least once) means they felt the E-stim
#All parts of phase 1-> expect to see a jump at part3

#  Phase 2 - part 1 (CONTEXT): Dist., freXY, freDXY
#  Phase 4 - part 1 (CONTEXT): Dist., freXY, freDXY
#decrease of freezing ?

#  Phase 3 - part 1 to 2  (CUE): Dist., freXY, freDXY
#increase of freezing between parts (when tone heard?)

#  Phase 5 - part 1 to 2  (CUE): Dist., freXY, freDXY
#increase of freezing between parts (when tone heard?)
#Curzon et al. 2009:  It has been shown that exposing rodents to foot shock will sometimes produce generalized, or nonassociative freezing to unconditioned stimuli, such as when placed in a novel environment. n our experience, we can see increased freezing to the tone stimulus in the novel environment in animals that have received contextual conditioning, i.e., those that have not been exposed to the tone during conditioning.

### AOCF MANUAL => number of freezing bouts, distance traveled, total time spent freezing

-->

```{r fear_load_data_c123}

#--------------------------- 1. Manual Entries -----------------------------#

#---------------------------LOAD DATA-----------------------------#
# Load lookup data files
lookupfile <- choose.files()  # "fear look up file_new.xlsx"

# Read lookup data files
lookup <- read_excel(paste(lookupfile,sep = ""))
names (lookup)[1] <- "Animal"
lookup <- lookup %>% 
  mutate(Animal = as.character(Animal),
         cohort = as.character(cohort)) 

# cohort 1
cohort1 <- choose.files()     
data1 <- read.csv(cohort1, header=T, skip=1, sep =";", dec = ",")
data1 <- data1[-1,]
data1$cohort <- "1"
data1 <- data1 %>% 
  mutate(Animal = as.character(Animal)) 

data1 <- data1 %>% 
  mutate(Animal=str_replace(Animal,"114", "14"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"115", "15"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"1104", "104"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"120", "20"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"144", "44"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"151", "51"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"1105", "105"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"1631", "631"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"117", "17"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"112", "12"))

#write.xlsx(data1, "feardata.xlsx", sheetName = "Sheet1", 
#  col.names = TRUE, row.names = TRUE, append = FALSE)

# cohort 2
cohort2 <- choose.files()    
data2 <- read.csv(cohort2, header=T, skip=1, sep =";", dec = ",")
data2 <- data2[-1,]
data2$cohort <- "2"
data2 <- data2 %>% 
  mutate(Animal = as.character(Animal)) 

data2 <- data2 %>% 
  mutate(Animal=str_replace(Animal,"110", "10"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"111", "11"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"190", "90"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"145", "45"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"414", "214"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"193", "93"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"189", "89"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"119", "19"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"116", "16"),         
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"136", "36"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"140", "40"))

# cohort 3
cohort3 <- choose.files()     
data3 <- read.csv(cohort3, header=T, skip=1, sep =";", dec = ",")
data3 <- data3[-1,]
data3$cohort <- "3"
data3 <- data3 %>% 
  mutate(Animal = as.character(Animal)) 

data3 <- data3 %>% 
  mutate(Animal=str_replace(Animal,"374", "74"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"453", "53"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"372", "72"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"375", "75"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"376", "76"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"378", "78"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"359", "59"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"362", "62"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"3101", "101"),
         Animal=str_replace(Animal,"452", "52"))

# Create data file with all cohort data
list_df123 <- list(data1, data2, data3)
data123 <- list_df123 %>% reduce(full_join, by=NULL)

# combine exp data with lookup data
#data_fr <- full_join(data1,lookup , by= c("cohort", "Animal"))
data_fr <- full_join(data123,lookup , by= c("cohort", "Animal"))
data_fr$cohort <- as.numeric(data_fr$cohort)

# need genotype to be factor for later stat analysis
data <- data_fr %>% mutate(geno = as.factor(genotype)) 

## Extract relevant data
# A.  Reaction to E-stim in phase 1
fear.p1 <- subset(data, Phase=='1')
fear.p1 <- fear.p1 %>% 
  select (Animal, geno, Phase, Part, Jump, Dis., FreXY, cohort) %>%
  mutate(Part=str_replace(Part,"1", "1.Habituation"),
         Part=str_replace(Part,"2", "2.Tone"),
         Part=str_replace(Part,"3", "3.E-stim"),
         Part=str_replace(Part,"4", "4.Pause"))

# B.  CONTEXT Conditionning
fear.ctx <- data %>%
  filter(Phase !="1", Phase !="3",Phase !="5") %>% #select lines
  select (Animal, geno, Phase, Part, Dis., FreXY, FreDXY, cohort) %>% #select columns
  mutate(Phase=str_replace(Phase,"2", "d2"),
         Phase=str_replace(Phase,"4", "d7"))

# C.1.  CUE Conditionning d2
fear.cue.d2 <- data %>% 
  filter(Phase !="1", Phase !="2",Phase !="4", Phase !="5") %>% #select lines
  select (Animal, geno, Phase, Part, Dis., FreXY, FreDXY, cohort) %>% #select columns
  mutate(Phase=str_replace(Phase,"3", "d2"),
         Part=str_replace(Part,"1", "ctx"),
         Part=str_replace(Part,"2", "cue")) 

# C.2.  CUE Conditionning d7
fear.cue.d7 <- data %>% 
  filter(Phase !="1", Phase !="2",Phase !="4", Phase !="3") %>% #select lines
  select (Animal, geno, Phase, Part, Dis., FreXY, FreDXY, cohort) %>% #select columns
  mutate(Phase=str_replace(Phase,"5", "d7"),
         Part=str_replace(Part,"1", "ctx"),
         Part=str_replace(Part,"2", "cue"))

```


```{r stat_func, echo=F}

# list of gender
list_of_genders <- c("F", "M")
list_of_genders <- as.factor(list_of_genders)

# list of phases
list_of_phases <- as.factor(c("d2", "d7"))

# list of parts
list_of_parts <- as.factor(c("ctx", "cue"))

# list of genotypes
list_of_genotypes <- c("Cre+", "hM4D+", "WT") 

# BETWEEN GENOTYPES for ctx
stats_ctx_bgeno <- function(data, parameter, info_text, grouping_factor="geno") {
 
  #create a tibble to collect all stats
  stats = tibble()
  
  df <- data %>%
    rename(param = all_of(parameter),
           group = all_of(grouping_factor))
    
  for (i in 1:length(list_of_phases)) {
    stat_data <- df %>%
      filter(Phase == list_of_phases[i])
  
    # perform Pairwise Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare between group difference
        st = tidy(pairwise.wilcox.test(stat_data$param, stat_data$group, p.adjust.methods = "BH", exact = FALSE)) %>%          
       mutate(method = "Pairwise Wilcoxon Sum",
              variable = info_text,
              test = paste("between genotypes for phase", list_of_phases[i]), 
              sign = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
 
  #combine stats from every iteration of the loop
  stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
  }
return(stats)
}

# BETWEEN GENOTYPES for cue
stats_cue_bgeno <- function(data, parameter, info_text, grouping_factor="geno") {
 
  #create a tibble to collect all stats
  stats = tibble()
  
  df <- data %>%
    rename(param = all_of(parameter),
           group = all_of(grouping_factor))
    
  for (i in 1:length(list_of_parts)) {
    stat_data <- df %>%
      filter(Part == list_of_parts[i])
  
    # perform Pairwise Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare between group difference
        st = tidy(pairwise.wilcox.test(stat_data$param, stat_data$group, p.adjust.methods = "BH", exact = FALSE)) %>%          
       mutate(method = "Pairwise Wilcoxon Sum",
              variable = info_text,
              test = paste("between genotypes for", list_of_parts[i]), 
              sign = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
 
  #combine stats from every iteration of the loop
  stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
  }
return(stats)
}

```

#### Phase 1 Conditioning (All Cohorts)

```{r boxplot_fear_cond_geno, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 11.5}

## Phase 1 (conditioning)

# Jump
pl.j.p1 <- fear.p1 %>%
#  filter(cohort==1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=factor(geno), y=Jump, color = factor(geno))) +  
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid (~factor(Part)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = factor(geno)),
             position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +
  labs(x="Conditioning steps", y="Jumping bouts", title = "Jumping in phase 1") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))
#pl.j.p1

# Distance
pl.dis.p1 <- fear.p1 %>%
#  filter(cohort==1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=factor(geno), y=Dis., color = factor(geno))) +   
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid (~factor(Part)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = factor(geno)),
             position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +
  labs(x="Conditioning steps", y="Distance traveled (cm)", title = "Distance traveled in phase 1") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))
#pl.dis.p1

# Freezing
pl.freez.p1 <- fear.p1 %>%
#  filter(cohort==1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=factor(geno), y=FreXY, color = factor(geno))) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid (~factor(Part)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = factor(geno)),
             position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +
  labs(x="Conditioning steps", y="Freezing bouts", title = "Freezing in phase 1") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",

# Create a grid with plots
```

```{r fear_stats_fig2, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))
```
